card.name: Words just before a named condition or drug
card.fires_on: Words in drug-label text where a medical condition, drug class or enzyme name is about to come next, such as "associated with", "between the" and "tics". It also fires partway through names like CYP2C9, HDV and tics.

modes.label: Linking words before a term
modes.description: Small words such as "with", "the" or "in" that sit right before the risk, drug or group being named.
modes.example: Hyperglycemia is associated<< with>> drugs that inhibit the PI3K/A

modes.label: Inside condition or enzyme names
modes.description: Partway through short medical names such as tics, HDV or CYP2C9.
modes.example: Regularly monitor patients for the emergence or worsening of t<<ics>> or Tourette’s syndrome.
